description: Comprehensive trading system that executes trades when ANY of the 6 strategies' conditions are met
execution_logic: OR - If any strategy's entry conditions are fully met, execute the trade

risk_reward_ratio.description: Never take trades below 1:2 RR. Aim for 1:3 when possible

position_sizing.description: Risk only 1-2% of total capital per trade

stop_loss_rules.buffer: Add 2-5 pips buffer beyond the structure to avoid stop hunts
stop_loss_rules.never: Never move stop loss against your position

risk_management.max_daily_loss: 4% of account - stop trading if hit

strategy_1_ict_fibonacci.name: ICT Inner Circle Trading with Fibonacci OTE
strategy_1_ict_fibonacci.description: Original ICT strategy with Fibonacci retracement and order blocks

ema_8.purpose: Fast trend direction on entry timeframe

order_blocks.definition: Last opposing candle before strong move

fair_value_gaps.definition: Price imbalance where wicks don't overlap
fair_value_gaps.purpose: Confluence with order blocks for entries

required_all: HTF trend is BULLISH (price above EMA 50 on 4H)
Break of Structure (BOS) to upside confirmed
Price retraces into OTE zone (0.618-0.786 Fibonacci)
Bullish Order Block identified in OTE zone
Fair Value Gap present for confluence
Currently in Kill Zone (London 07:00-10:00 GMT or NY 13:00-16:00 GMT)
Confirmation candle: bullish engulfing, hammer, or strong rejection wick
LTF bias aligns with HTF (price above EMA 8 and 21 on 15m)
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
long.entry_trigger: Close of confirmation candle in OTE zone
long.stop_loss: Below order block low + 5 pip buffer
long.take_profit: Previous swing high or 1:3 RR level

required_all: HTF trend is BEARISH (price below EMA 50 on 4H)
Break of Structure (BOS) to downside confirmed
Price retraces into OTE zone (0.618-0.786 Fibonacci)
Bearish Order Block identified in OTE zone
Fair Value Gap present for confluence
Currently in Kill Zone (London 07:00-10:00 GMT or NY 13:00-16:00 GMT)
Confirmation candle: bearish engulfing, shooting star, or strong rejection wick
LTF bias aligns with HTF (price below EMA 8 and 21 on 15m)
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
short.entry_trigger: Close of confirmation candle in OTE zone
short.stop_loss: Above order block high + 5 pip buffer
short.take_profit: Previous swing low or 1:3 RR level

avoid_trade_if: HTF trend is NEUTRAL or choppy
No clear BOS in trend direction
Price has not reached OTE zone (0.618-0.786)
No order block or FVG confluence
Outside kill zone hours
High-impact news event within 30 minutes
Risk-reward ratio below 1:2
Already hit max trades per day (3)

strategy_2_cisd.name: CISD (Candle in Supply/Demand)
strategy_2_cisd.description: Identifies supply/demand zones and waits for candle to close inside the zone for entry

supply_demand_zones.definition: Areas where price previously reversed sharply
supply_demand_zones.fresh_zone: Zone that hasn't been tested yet

required_all: Fresh demand zone identified on HTF (4H/Daily)
Price approaches demand zone from above
Candle closes INSIDE the demand zone (not just wick)
Volume spike on approach to zone
HTF trend is bullish or neutral
No major resistance directly above
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
long.entry_trigger: Close of candle inside demand zone
long.stop_loss: Below demand zone low + 5 pip buffer
long.take_profit: Next supply zone or 1:3 RR level

required_all: Fresh supply zone identified on HTF (4H/Daily)
Price approaches supply zone from below
Candle closes INSIDE the supply zone (not just wick)
Volume spike on approach to zone
HTF trend is bearish or neutral
No major support directly below
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
short.entry_trigger: Close of candle inside supply zone
short.stop_loss: Above supply zone high + 5 pip buffer
short.take_profit: Next demand zone or 1:3 RR level

avoid_trade_if: Zone has been tested multiple times (not fresh)
No volume confirmation
Price only wicks into zone without body close
Major support/resistance blocking path to TP
Risk-reward ratio below 1:2

strategy_3_fvg_cisd_combined.name: FVG + CISD Combined Strategy
strategy_3_fvg_cisd_combined.description: Identifies Fair Value Gap on HTF, waits for price to tap it, then uses CISD on LTF for entry confirmation

fair_value_gap_htf.definition: Price imbalance on 4H/Daily where wicks don't overlap
fair_value_gap_htf.purpose: Primary target zone for price to return

required_all: Bullish Fair Value Gap identified on HTF (4H/Daily)
Price taps into the FVG zone (50% fill minimum)
Switch to 15m timeframe
Identify fresh demand zone on 15m within the HTF FVG
Candle closes inside the 15m demand zone
HTF trend is bullish
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
long.entry_trigger: Close of candle inside 15m demand zone that's within HTF FVG
long.stop_loss: Below 15m demand zone low + 5 pip buffer
long.take_profit: HTF FVG fill completion or 1:3 RR level

required_all: Bearish Fair Value Gap identified on HTF (4H/Daily)
Price taps into the FVG zone (50% fill minimum)
Switch to 15m timeframe
Identify fresh supply zone on 15m within the HTF FVG
Candle closes inside the 15m supply zone
HTF trend is bearish
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
short.entry_trigger: Close of candle inside 15m supply zone that's within HTF FVG
short.stop_loss: Above 15m supply zone high + 5 pip buffer
short.take_profit: HTF FVG fill completion or 1:3 RR level

avoid_trade_if: HTF FVG has already been fully filled (100%)
No clear supply/demand zone on 15m within the FVG
HTF trend opposes the FVG direction
Risk-reward ratio below 1:2

strategy_4_fibonacci_retracement.name: Fibonacci Retracement Strategy
strategy_4_fibonacci_retracement.description: Uses Fibonacci levels (0.5, 0.62, 0.79) for reversal entries during trends

required_all: HTF trend is BULLISH (uptrend confirmed)
Impulse move up identified (swing low to swing high)
Fibonacci drawn from swing low to swing high
Price pulls back to 0.5, 0.618, or 0.786 Fibonacci level
Bullish reversal candle at Fibonacci level (hammer, engulfing, pin bar)
Stop loss can be placed below recent swing low
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
long.entry_trigger: Close of bullish reversal candle at Fib level
long.stop_loss: Below recent swing low + 5 pip buffer
long.take_profit: Previous swing high or 1:3 RR level

required_all: HTF trend is BEARISH (downtrend confirmed)
Impulse move down identified (swing high to swing low)
Fibonacci drawn from swing high to swing low
Price rallies to 0.5, 0.618, or 0.786 Fibonacci level
Bearish reversal candle at Fibonacci level (shooting star, engulfing, pin bar)
Stop loss can be placed above recent swing high
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
short.entry_trigger: Close of bearish reversal candle at Fib level
short.stop_loss: Above recent swing high + 5 pip buffer
short.take_profit: Previous swing low or 1:3 RR level

avoid_trade_if: HTF trend is unclear or ranging
No clear impulse move to draw Fibonacci from
Price doesn't reach key Fibonacci levels (0.5, 0.618, 0.786)
No reversal candle pattern at Fibonacci level
Risk-reward ratio below 1:2

strategy_5_smt_divergence.name: SMT (Smart Money Tool) Divergence Strategy
strategy_5_smt_divergence.description: Compares two correlated assets for divergence signals indicating trend reversal

divergence_indicator.definition: When one asset fails to make new high/low while other does

required_all: Both assets in downtrend
Primary asset (BTC) makes new lower low
Secondary asset (ETH) FAILS to make new lower low (bullish divergence)
Divergence confirmed on HTF (4H/Daily)
Switch to LTF (1H/15m) for entry confirmation
Bullish reversal pattern on LTF (engulfing, hammer, BOS to upside)
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
long.entry_trigger: Close of bullish reversal candle after divergence confirmation
long.stop_loss: Below recent swing low on primary asset + 5 pip buffer
long.take_profit: Previous swing high or 1:3 RR level

required_all: Both assets in uptrend
Primary asset (BTC) makes new higher high
Secondary asset (ETH) FAILS to make new higher high (bearish divergence)
Divergence confirmed on HTF (4H/Daily)
Switch to LTF (1H/15m) for entry confirmation
Bearish reversal pattern on LTF (engulfing, shooting star, BOS to downside)
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio achievable
short.entry_trigger: Close of bearish reversal candle after divergence confirmation
short.stop_loss: Above recent swing high on primary asset + 5 pip buffer
short.take_profit: Previous swing low or 1:3 RR level

avoid_trade_if: No clear divergence between correlated assets
Divergence on LTF only (must be HTF divergence)
No reversal confirmation on LTF
Assets are not correlated (check correlation coefficient)
Risk-reward ratio below 1:2

execution_logic_detailed.description: The bot will check ALL strategies in parallel. If ANY strategy's entry conditions are fully met, execute the trade.
execution_logic_detailed.priority_system: If multiple strategies signal at the same time, use the one with highest priority (lowest number)
execution_logic_detailed.conflict_resolution: If one strategy signals LONG and another signals SHORT simultaneously, DO NOT TRADE (wait for clarity)
validation_order: 1. Check global risk management (max trades per day, max daily loss)
2. Check each strategy's entry conditions in parallel
3. If any strategy passes all conditions, prepare trade
5. Execute trade with strategy-specific stop loss and take profit
6. Log which strategy triggered the trade

filters: Maximum 3 trades per day across all strategies
Stop trading if daily loss reaches 4% of account
Avoid trading 30 minutes before/after high-impact news (NFP, FOMC, CPI)
Minimum 1:2 risk-reward ratio required for all trades
No trading during major holidays or low liquidity periods
If 2 consecutive losses, reduce position size by 50% for next trade
Never have more than 2 open positions simultaneously

partial_profits.second_target: Let remaining 50% run to 1:3 or higher

trade_management.breakeven_rule: Move stop to entry +/- spread once trade is 1:1.5 in profit
trade_management.trailing_stop: Optional - trail stop by 1 ATR once in 1:2 profit
trade_management.max_hold_time: Close trade if no movement toward TP within 24 hours (discretionary)

for_each_trade_log: Which strategy triggered the trade (strategy_1 through strategy_6)
All entry conditions that were met
Entry price, stop loss, take profit levels
Outcome: TP hit, SL hit, or manual close

notes.important: This is a multi-strategy system. The bot will be MORE active than a single-strategy system because it has 6 different ways to enter trades.
notes.risk_warning: With more entry opportunities comes more risk. Strictly enforce max trades per day and max daily loss limits.
notes.backtesting: Backtest each strategy individually first, then test the combined system.
notes.optimization: After 30 days of live trading, review which strategies have highest win rate and adjust priorities accordingly.
